other_failure_modes.name: Unencoded target for LightGBM multiclass
other_failure_modes.description: LightGBM's multiclass objective strictly requires target labels to be integers in the range [0, num_classes - 1]. Failing to LabelEncode the target variable when it contains strings, floats, or non-consecutive integers will result in an execution crash.

other_failure_modes.name: Unencoded categorical features
other_failure_modes.description: LightGBM cannot handle string/object columns natively unless they are explicitly cast to the pandas 'category' dtype. Passing raw object columns directly to the model causes an execution error.
